ireġesü: ire- — to come; conditional -ġesü, 'when, if (he) came' (verb, conditional; Ming 來了呵) [來了呵] · also with the Ming 來呵 'if (he) comes'
keleležü: kele- — to speak, to say; -le- verb-maker, converb -žü, 'speaking' (verb, converb) [說着]
ger-ün: ger-ün — of the tent, of the house (ger + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [房的]
ümerēče: ümer — behind, back; ablative -ēče, 'from behind' (noun + case; the same as ümer-eče, written with a long ē) [自後] · also with Ming 北處 ('the north place'), ger-ün ümerēče, 'from behind the tent'
qamtu: qamtu — together, jointly (adverb) [一同] · also glossed Ming 一箇 'one' ('together' remains the reading; sense uncertain)
baižu: bai- — to stand, stay; converb -žu, 'standing' (verb, converb) [立着]
saγ̇uri: saγ̇uri — seat, place of sitting, one's rank in sitting (noun; Ming 坐次, 坐位) [坐次]
ken: ken — who (interrogative pronoun) [誰] · also Ken, a river name (not ken 'who'; Ming 河名) [河名]
ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
saγ̇utuγai: saγu- — to sit; optative -tuγai, 'let them sit' (the Ming 敎 'cause' is not shown in the form) (verb, optative) [敎坐者︀]
kelen: kelen — word, speech, language (noun) [言語] · also 'word, speech' (Ming 話)
jabutuγai: jabu- — to go, walk about; optative -tuγai, 'let them go' (the Ming 敎 'cause' suggests 'let them make go'; uncertain) (verb, optative) [敎行者︀]
jabuqun: jabu- — to walk, to go about, to travel; participle -qun, 'the one going' (verb, participle; the ending is uncertain, Ming 行的) [行的]
barituγai: bari- — to take hold of, seize; -tuγai optative: 'let them ...' (Ming 敎 'let') [敎拿]
aγta: aγta — gelding (noun; Ming 騸馬) [騸馬] · also 'gelding, horse; livestock' (Ming 頭疋), with ere, 'men and animals'
emeġeltü: emeġel — saddle; possessive -tü, 'saddle-having, saddled' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [鞍有的]
selte: selte — with, bringing along (word uncertain; read from the Ming 帶) [帶] · also 'together with, including' (Ming 連) [連]
abtuγai: ab- — to take, receive; optative -tuγai, 'let him receive' (verb, optative, third person) [受者︀]
böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣] · also bü- 'to be', converb -tele, 'while' (Ming 有間)
žilda: žilda — late, evening (read from the Ming 晩) (adverb; uncertain) [晩]
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住) · also dobtulqu bolun 'about to charge, bent on charging' (Ming 要 'wish to'; compare bailduqu bolun) · also with Ming 做 'becoming' (plain converb, ködölkün bolun)
ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
